title: Hooded Sorcerer in Ruins
description: A hooded figure in a flowing purple robe with golden arcane patterns stands on cracked stone ground. The figure holds a glowing lantern in one hand and a burning torch emitting thick orange smoke in the other, surrounded by scattered torn purple fabric and debris under a dark sky.
